name: catenary-web
description: Catenary web client — first-pass implementation of the design canvas (IDEA-23).

scripts.build: npm run gen:check && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.smoke: npm run gen:check && npm run build:smoke && npm run smoke:live && npm run conformance && npm run outbox
scripts.conformance: vite build --ssr conformance.ts --outDir dist-conformance --logLevel warn && node dist-conformance/conformance.js
scripts.validate: vite build --ssr validate.ts --outDir dist-validate --logLevel warn && node dist-validate/validate.js
scripts.readstate: vite build --ssr readstate.ts --outDir dist-readstate --logLevel warn && node dist-readstate/readstate.js
scripts.test:transport: vite build --ssr transport.test.ts --outDir dist-transport-test --logLevel warn && node --test dist-transport-test/transport.test.js
scripts.outbox: vite build --ssr outbox.test.ts --outDir dist-outbox --logLevel warn && node --test dist-outbox/outbox.test.js
